title: find_records input
description: Finds a record by its record number, for the web app's global search: an application (APP), an intake request (IR), a decision (DEC), a change request (CHG), a review (REV) a configuration draft (CFG) or a data use (DU). The prefix names the kind of record; the digits match with or without leading zeros, so DEC-123 finds DEC-0123. Rows the caller may not read are never found. Writes nothing.

recordNumber.description: The record number as people write it, such as DEC-0123, dec 123 or IR0108. The prefix is one of APP, IR, DEC, CHG, REV, CFG and DU.
